what: bootstrap: skeleton, checks, 3 cities (nakatsu, hikone, kitamoto), 5 languages, move-in scene, daycare fee calculator
why: first build from CLAUDE.md

what: dependency: yaml
why: data, scenes and wording are YAML; Node has no built-in parser

what: drift reports through an issue labelled drift instead of writing to state/backlog
why: a workflow cannot push to main, and PRs opened with the workflow token do not run checks

what: check.yml runs on pull_request_target and judges PRs with gate/ and x from main; fork PRs are skipped; no npm cache
why: a PR could otherwise rewrite its own checks; pull_request_target runs PR code, so the token is read-only, forks are excluded and the cache is not shared with deploy

what: check.yml: removed the pull_request trigger; only pull_request_target remains
why: the pull_request run read the workflow from the PR; machi-navi#2 confirmed the new workflow passes and auto-merge works

what: second-child rules and the free age 3-5 note now have quotes; records may list the wording keys they back (wording: [...]); dropped the program name from rule_free
why: the name of the Oita program is not in the cited fee document

what: child allowance deadline now cites the Children and Families Agency; move-in deadline cites the Digital Agency FAQ; the online move-out period still cites Nakatsu
why: national facts should cite national bodies; no national page stating the 30/10-day period was found yet

what: added Kumamoto; fee tables may carry tax_adjust (num/den) and the calculator rescales the tax before the tier lookup
why: Kumamoto levies 8% and its fee table is written for 6%; the source says to multiply by 6/8

what: skipped Sendai and Niigata
why: their fiscal 2026 fee tables are images inside the PDF, so amounts cannot be matched against the text

what: added Kitakyushu with tax_adjust 6/8 and second_child free
why: the fee notice says the table is read at the old 6% rate while the city levies 8%, and that second and later children are free regardless of the older child

what: a city may carry office-hours.yaml (city hall opening hours with its own source); the page shows it only when the move-in page states no hours
why: the move-in pages of Hikone and Kitamoto give no hours; the opening hours are shown under their own label and source instead of being written as reception hours

what: kept the Nakatsu page as the source for the online move-out period (30 days before to 10 days after) and closed the backlog item
why: the Digital Agency FAQ, leaflets and news articles, the Mynaportal moving pages and the ministry slides found by search do not state the period in text, so no national page could be quoted

what: added Hiroshima; second_child gains half_any (half price regardless of the older sibling's age) with its own wording
why: Hiroshima counts siblings of any age, so the existing wording about children enrolled at the same time would be wrong; the amount is still half

what: dropped half_any from second_child; the page now takes the second-child text from the rule_* key in the fee table's wording list
why: the check on main rejected the new second_child value; the amount is plain half, and only the wording differs, so the wording list carries the difference without changing the checks

what: fee tables carry second_child_quote (index into quotes); the calculator shows that sentence under the second-child rule
why: cities count the second child differently; showing the city's own sentence avoids adding a wording variant per city, and the sentence is already checked against the source snapshot

what: added Okayama; tier C6 printed as two rows with equal amounts is stored as one tier; opening hours of the ward offices go to office-hours.yaml
why: the fee notice gives amounts as text; the second-child amounts in parentheses equal half of the first-child amounts, so second_child is half

what: fixed drift.yml (a run value held an unquoted colon-space, so the file was not valid YAML) and added a check that every workflow file parses
why: the drift workflow had never run since the first build; GitHub records an unreadable workflow only as a failed push run, which no check looked at

what: changes to gate/, x and .github/ keep merging without an owner label
why: the owner answered 2 (keep as is) on issue #8; weakening checks stays forbidden by CLAUDE.md and is reviewed afterwards

what: city.yaml carries pref (JIS code); the entry page groups cities by prefecture, the heading taken from the city name
why: seven cities in one list were getting hard to scan; the comparison chart stays as one list because seven bars still fit

what: added Shizuoka using the 6% boundaries of its fee table with tax_adjust 6/8
